label: Looking back over your adult life have nervous or emotional troubles ever stopped you from working or doing domestic chores or having social contacts for a fortnight or longer? - at age 43 years
meta_rows: Looking back over your adult life have nervous or emotional troubles ever stopped you from working or doing domestic chores or having social contacts for a fortnight or longer? - at age 43 years
Psyhciatric Symptom Frequency Scale. How have you been feeling about things over the last year. Asked in the 1989 questionnaire (at age 43 years).
cat_rows: This category contains the psychiatric symptom frequency inventory scale (PSF; Rodgers, 1994). This was administered by nurses. The PSF is an interview-based scale of symptoms of anxiety and depression over the previous 12 months. The reliability and validity of this measure is reported by Lindelow et al. (1997).
val_rows: Yes, but not in the last year
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
